title: jitso init in a project that holds the block of an older jitso replaces it where it stands and keeps every byte outside it
source: intended: jitso init is the one command that brings a project up to date (docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories")
intent: A project set up by an earlier release carries rules that no longer hold. doctor names the older block number, init replaces the block in AGENTS.md and a second run has nothing to do.

stdout: warn instructions: block 1 in AGENTS.md is older than block 2 (run jitso setup instructions)

stdout.equals: jitso init: nothing to do (JITSO is already set up here)
